evals.prompt: Run object detection on a local video file using CPU and stream the results via RTSP. The DL Streamer Pipeline Server repo is already cloned. Show how to start the service and launch a pipeline on a sample video.
evals.expected_output: A complete walkthrough covering how to start the DL Streamer Pipeline Server container, send a REST request to launch a CPU-based detection pipeline on a video file, and view the RTSP stream output.
expectations: Shows cd into microservices/dlstreamer-pipeline-server/docker and docker compose up.
Uses port 8080 for the REST API.
Sends a POST to /pipelines/user_defined_pipelines/pallet_defect_detection or equivalent pipeline path.
Includes source.uri with a file:// path and source.type=uri in the request body.
Sets device to CPU in the parameters.
Shows RTSP output accessible at rtsp://<host>:8554/<stream-name>.
Shows how to check pipeline status via GET /pipelines/status or /pipelines/{instance_id}/status.
Shows how to stop the pipeline via DELETE /pipelines/{instance_id}.

evals.prompt: Set up GPU-accelerated inference on a video stream and publish detection metadata to an MQTT broker. The system has an Intel GPU and an MQTT broker is running at 192.168.1.50:1883. Show the full setup.
evals.expected_output: A GPU inference walkthrough covering how to configure GPU access, mount the GPU pipeline config, start the service with MQTT environment variables, and launch a pipeline that publishes to MQTT.
expectations: Shows setting RENDER_GID via stat -c %g /dev/dri/render* or equivalent.
Sets MQTT_HOST and MQTT_PORT environment variables (in .env or exported).
Mounts the GPU config (configs/sample_gpu_decode_and_inference/config.json) or explains the GPU pipeline string with vah264dec and device=GPU.
Uses port 8080 for the REST API.
Sets metadata destination type to mqtt with a topic field in the request body.
Mentions adding vapostproc ! video/x-raw before appsink for RTSP/MQTT compatibility with GPU pipelines.
Does not use port 8200 or confuse this with the model-download service.
